{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Check how many missing values in 'sex' per species
df_sex_missing = df.groupby('species')['sex'].apply(lambda x: x.isnull().sum())
print("Missing 'sex' by species:")
print(df_sex_missing)"}
